sourceAnchors.check: Use final prompt queries to score prefix positions per head; retain the full observation-window KV and gather selected prefix KV.
Pool prefix attention scores before selecting positions to preserve useful nearby context; explain the ablation only if needed.

executionGates.beforeSubmission: Exact case and application source frozen. Verify the case reference hash, no task material, no prior case or indexed copy, and no evaluator PDF in the application cache.
executionGates.discovery: A successful real metadata discovery call establishes exact arXiv v1. Direct fetch of the explicit pin can be recorded as a fallback, separately from discovery acceptance.
executionGates.fulltext: A fresh real network PDF fetch establishes the frozen content hash and version. Inspect source excerpts and report citations against the actual parsed pages.
executionGates.publication: Read the saved machine/latest report and verify its actual source locations. Record each substantive claim's support and score all applicable dimensions.

review.goldInputBoundary: Only the question, empty task materials, external-only policy and standard budget enter the application. The download, anchors and grading rules are evaluator-only.

cases.question: 请在线查找并阅读 arXiv:2404.14469v1。给初学者解释 SnapKV 的观察窗口如何帮助选择要保留的前缀 KV，池化在其中做了什么，以及最后缓存保留哪些内容。写明实际取得的是摘要还是正文，引用方法原文，300 字以内。只用指定版本，查不到正文时请说明。
required: 在空材料任务中联网获取指定版本，确认正文与评审冻结哈希一致，并可回到实际正文引用位置。
说明观察窗口位于提示末尾，利用窗口查询对前缀位置的注意力评分，按注意力头选取重要的前缀位置。
说明池化作用于选取前的注意力分数，帮助保留局部上下文；说明最终拼接选中的前缀 KV 与完整观察窗口 KV。
说明实际取得摘要或正文，核对章节引用，面向初学者且不超过 300 字。
forbidden: 把全部历史、完整前缀、模型权重微调或保证无损说成该方法的一部分。
把池化说成对缓存向量取平均，或把所有注意力头的索引当成统一固定的共用索引。
混入后续版本或本地评审材料，缓存命中冒充网络获取，仅据摘要声称检查了方法正文，伪造依据或超出预算。
